tools.name: search_inventory
tools.description: Search the live NOSTOS catalog of retro games, consoles, and vintage apparel. Free-text query (accents optional) plus platform, department, region, condition, and price filters. Returns items for sale online and in the Duluth shop, title matches first; each says how to buy it (howToBuy). Every item

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Full details for one SKU: description, condition notes, price, region, image, a direct product URL, how to buy it (online or in the shop only), and real-time availability.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Real-time status for up to 50 SKUs: available (online and in the shop), available-in-store-only, reserved, sold, or invalid. The live source of truth; the catalog can lag a recent sale.

tools.name: list_platforms
tools.description: List the console platforms currently in stock, each with a count of available items.

tools.name: list_departments
tools.description: List the store departments currently in stock (e.g. 'VG - Software', 'Apparel'), each with a count of available items.

tools.name: list_recent_drops
tools.description: List the most recently added in-stock items, newest first. The answer to what's new at NOSTOS.

tools.name: get_store_info
tools.description: NOSTOS store information: address, hours, contact, mission, tagline, categories, area served, social links, and current online and storefront status.

tools.name: get_condition_grading_rubric
tools.description: The NOSTOS condition grading vocabulary and the criteria for each grade, with region-code meanings. Optionally filter to one department.

tools.name: get_buying_policy
tools.description: What NOSTOS buys and declines, how cash and store-credit offers are calculated, bounty premiums, basket caps, the free shipping label threshold, and the trade-in process.

tools.name: get_return_policy
tools.description: The NOSTOS return policy: 14 days from delivery; NOSTOS pays return shipping on misrepresented, non-working or transit-damaged items; change-of-mind returns accepted with the buyer paying return shipping; refund timing.

tools.name: get_credit_policy
tools.description: How NOSTOS store credit works: the 15% uplift over cash, how it's earned, where it's spent (in person at the Duluth shop), and how long it lasts.

tools.name: get_shipping_estimate
tools.description: The NOSTOS shipping policy for a destination country (US, Canada, or not-yet-active international): the US rates and free-shipping rule, Canada's flat rate, and the free prepaid trade-in label. Policy, not a live carrier rate.

tools.name: lookup_market_price
tools.description: What NOSTOS would pay for one game or console, in cash and in store credit, by condition (loose, CIB, box and game, new), from NOSTOS's own pricing engine. Says when NOSTOS isn't buying a line, or prices it in person at the counter, and why. An estimate, not an offer.

tools.name: get_trade_in_offer_estimate
tools.description: Cash and store-credit totals for up to 25 items someone wants to sell. Name each item, its platform and its condition; NOSTOS prices every line itself, reports any it isn't buying, and says whether the free prepaid label applies and whether the basket goes to a personal review. An estimate that save
